khan_imf_singapore_2024.label: IMF SIP/2024/040 — Impact of AI on Singapore's Labor Market (Khan)
khan_imf_singapore_2024.framing: IMF reports absolute economy-wide employment shares using the Cazzaniga et al. (2024) exposure x complementarity framework. This repo's exposure is percentile-ranked within 562 Singapore occupations, so absolute shares are not comparable; only the occupational pattern and the complementarity split direction are.
